hook.evidence: Introduces importance of secure trust management for underwater sensor networks.

gap.evidence: Notes limited guidance on trust management tailored to UWSN constraints.

yes_but.evidence: Acknowledges existing security surveys but highlights missing UWSN-focused trust treatment.

contribution.evidence: States contributions: attack/security requirements, trust foundations, trust management modifications, and open issues.

scope_boundary.evidence: Focus on trust management in UWSNs including attacks, metrics, challenges, and guidelines.

rhetorical_moves_global.reader_contract_pattern: Motivate UWSN trust need; outline attack/security requirements; present trust concepts/metrics; discuss challenges; propose management modifications; highlight open issues; conclude.

visuals_tables.layout_logic: Figures/tables illustrate trust concepts, evidence, and applications; comparison elements appear in trust management section; open issues and lessons are text-heavy.

figures.purpose: depict trust components/metrics and UWSN context

tables.purpose: summarize trust evidence/metrics or application mappings

lesson_blocks.lesson: Phase threats and security requirements frame why trust is needed.
Standardizing trust metrics and evidence enables consistent evaluation across UWSNs.
Underwater constraints demand modified trust evaluation and management versus WSNs.
Future work should target robust trust computation under harsh channels and limited resources.

synthesis.aha_moment: Aligning trust metrics and evidence with underwater constraints, then modifying trust evaluation accordingly, turns generic WSN trust models into UWSN-ready guidelines.

style.section_openers_pattern: Introduce topic then enumerate sub-elements (attacks, metrics, trust components) with supportive tables/figures.

reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Grounds trust design in explicit threats and requirements.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Underwater-specific modifications after comparison
steps: Compare UWSN trust evaluation with WSNs.

Present trust management schemes that implement these modifications.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Shows rationale for design changes and ties them to concrete schemes.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Open issues paired with computation discussion
steps: List future research directions specific to UWSN trust.
